title: Template -- User-writable process injects into LSASS
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin canonical templates
description: Canonical Sigma detection template for MITRE ATT&CK T1055 (Process Injection). Detects Sysmon CreateRemoteThread telemetry where a process from a common user-writable location creates a remote thread in LSASS. This is a narrow high-signal template; it requires endpoint telemetry that records SourceImage and TargetImage. Synthetic exemplar from the WinstonRedGuard threat-intel corpus -- no actor binding; review and bind to your environment before deployment.
